name: Durendal
powers: Indestructible blade whose pommel holds relics of Saint Peter, Saint Basil and Saint Denis.
description: Durendal, Roland's sword in the eleventh-century Chanson de Roland. Its gilded pommel holds a tooth of Saint Peter, blood of Saint Basil and hair of Saint Denis. Wounded at Roncevaux, Roland tries to break it against a rock rather than let it fall to the Saracens; the blade survives and the rock splits.

name: Sword of Attila
material: Iron with gold and gem-set hilt
powers: Blade of world dominion pledged to Attila.
description: The sword said to have belonged to Attila the Hun and kept among Hungarian royal treasures. The Roman historian Jordanes records that a shepherd found a blade in the ground that Attila called the Sword of Mars, pledge of world dominion. The gilded iron saber shown in Vienna's Kunsthistorisches Museum is identified with it in later tradition.
